entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: The governing authority of Ghirapur whose laws bind citizens and which confiscates inventions.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: An infamous renegade captured by the Consulate and set to face Tezzeret at the Grand Exhibition.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Head Judge of the Inventors' Fair who demands citizens surrender their inventions and captures Pia Nalaar.

entities.name: Sram
entities.description: A senior edificer who sees Ghirapur's gremlins as threats to be eliminated.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: A city on Kaladesh, a beacon of inspiration attracting brilliant minds.

entities.name: Baral
entities.description: The Consulate's Chief of Compliance, who has met a pyromancer before.

entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: An aether-seer whose experiments suggested multiple realities and who saw the Great Conduit.

entities.name: Inventors' Fair
entities.description: A competition of inventors in Ghirapur where open hostilities are forbidden.

entities.name: Grand Exhibition
entities.description: An exhibition where Tezzeret is to face Pia Nalaar.

entities.name: Oviya Pashiri
entities.description: A sage lifecrafter who believes inspiration is reciprocal.

entities.name: Great Conduit
entities.description: A wonder Rashmi perceived after opening her mind.

entities.name: Kambal
entities.description: Consul of Allocation with "friends" high and low who owe him favors.

entities.name: Faiz
entities.description: An inventor who admires Tezzeret's vision.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane on which Ghirapur lies, known for its foundries.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: An artist-inventor who knows what metal wants to be.

events.summary: Tezzeret captures the infamous Pia Nalaar.
The Consulate orders citizens to surrender their inventions on Tezzeret's behalf.
events.quote: Tezzeret bids you to surrender your inventions. Now.

events.summary: Baral confronts a pyromancer he has met before.
events.quote: "We meet again, pyromancer." —Baral, Chief of Compliance

events.summary: Rashmi's experiments lead her to consider multiple realities.
events.quote: The results of Rashmi's experimentation forced her to consider the possibility that multitudinous realities existed beyond her own.

events.summary: Tezzeret is to face Pia Nalaar at the Grand Exhibition.
events.quote: Tonight at the Grand Exhibition, witness Head Judge Tezzeret face off against the infamous renegade Pia Nalaar.
It was only then that I could see the Great Conduit.
